integrity: Proof is a symbolic finite-dimensional decomposition and beta-moment calculation; executable finite checks are consistency tests, not an all-dimensional certificate. Literature priority remains subject to external review.
scientific_limitations: Only pure degree-three harmonics on real spheres of dimension d-1>=2 and equal antipodal polar caps, with 0<t<1. Endpoint cases have full degeneracy. No assertion for low-pass bands or unequal caps.
title: Two sharp concentration transitions for cubic spherical harmonics on antipodal caps
